title: Saab 340 Finally Explained! CTOT & Engine Guide (MSFS 2024)
description:
The Saab 340 is a beast, but most pilots fly it wrong. From the complex GE CT7 engine logic to the infamous CTOT system, we’re revealing the secrets to mastering this Swedish legend in MSFS 2024.

In Part 2 of our masterclass, we dive into why your Saab might struggle to reach 25,000ft. It’s all in the EFB weight and balance. We’re doing a full walkaround, a technical teardown of the engine "brain" (ECU/HMU), and a live demo of the APR safety system in action. Don't stall on the ramp—learn to fly the Saab 340 like a pro.

What You’ll Learn in Part 2:

- Military Design: Why the JAS 39 Gripen "Diffusion Bonding" matters.
- EFB Masterclass: Setting payload and fuel without exceeding MTOW.
- Engine Anatomy: The axial-centrifugal secrets of the GE CT7-9B.
- CTOT & APR: How to use Constant Torque for perfect takeoffs.

📖 Chapters:
0:00 - Part 2: What You’ll Master Today
01:20 - Saab 340 Walkaround & Ground Ops

09:52 - CTOT Explained: Constant Torque on Takeoff
